scenes.tts: Close your eyes. A vibrator on your biceps tendon, at one hundred hertz, can make you misjudge where your elbow is. The joint has not moved. In one classic experiment on human subjects, the error reached as much as forty degrees while the muscle contracted. So your sense of limb position is a computed estimate, built from sensors you cannot feel.

scenes.tts: Position is read from populations of afferents, not from one receptor. Take the muscle spindle. It has two sensory endings, a primary ending called I A, and a secondary ending called type two. Both signal static muscle length. I A endings are also more sensitive to the rate of change. So the old rule, that I A is velocity and type two is position, is wrong.
scenes.caption: Position is read from populations of afferents, not from one receptor. Take the muscle spindle. It has two sensory endings, a primary ending called Ia, and a secondary ending called type II. Both signal static muscle length. Ia endings are also more sensitive to the rate of change. So the old rule, that Ia is velocity and II is position, is wrong.

scenes.tts: Human recordings separate the two classes by vibration. In the leg of healthy people, one study recorded fifteen primary and five secondary endings. The secondary endings were less sensitive to low-amplitude tendon vibration. So primary endings are the likely carriers of the illusion. But the experiments do not show that only they act.

scenes.tts: Which protein turns stretch into current at a spindle ending? A channel called Piezo two. In mouse, three kinds of evidence were gathered. First, where it is. A reporter showed it in endings on spindles and tendon organs. Second, what current it carries. Dissociated sensory neurons gave rapidly adapting currents. Third, whether the ending needs it. Deleting it sharply reduced stretch-evoked firing.

scenes.tts: In mouse cell bodies in culture, twenty three of twenty five labelled neurons had rapidly adapting currents. The label marks proprioceptors and some other neurons. The inactivation time constant was five point six milliseconds. Assume one exponential decay. That is our assumption, not the paper's. About seventeen percent is left at ten milliseconds, and about three percent at twenty.

scenes.tts: A small stretch response remained after deletion, in one of eight muscles for each mouse line. So Piezo two is the principal transducer, not the only one. In humans, two people with inactivating PIEZO two variants were markedly worse at reaching and joint-angle tasks without visual cues. Two people are a clinical series. Keep this rule. Limb position is an estimate from many signals.
